_schema_info.title: Nautilus Law Group — Estate Planning Questionnaire: Webhook Payload Reference
_schema_info.description: Complete field-by-field reference for the Make.com webhook POST body. Every field sent on form submission is documented here with its type, allowed values, validation rules, and the condition under which it appears. Fields marked required:true will block form progression if empty. Fields with a condition key only appear when that condition is true. null values in the payload indicate the field is not applicable for this submission (e.g. client_2 is null for single clients).
_schema_info.validation_summary: Validation runs page-by-page as the user clicks Next. All required fields on the current page must be filled before advancing. Conditional required fields (e.g. urgentDetail) are only required when their parent field has a specific value.

submitted_at._description: Timestamp of when the form was submitted

session_id._description: Browser session identifier generated per visit, used for deduplication

engagement._description: Top-level engagement metadata about this matter

type._description: Determines whether client_2 is populated and whether couple-specific pages appear
type._impact: If starts with 'Couple', client_2 object is populated; otherwise client_2 is null

state._description: Australian state or territory where the client resides

referral._description: How the client heard about Nautilus Law Group

referrer_name._description: Full name of the referrer (first + last joined with space)
referrer_name._source: Concatenation of refFirst and refLast fields

referrer_firm._description: Firm or organisation of the referrer

client_1._description: Always present. Full profile for the primary client.
client_1._schema_ref: See CLIENT_SCHEMA below — applies identically to client_1 and client_2

postal_address._description: Postal address. If postalSame=Yes, equals residential address. If No, separately entered.

employer._description: Employer or business name; 'Self-employed' or 'N/A' accepted

relationship_date._description: Approximate date relationship began; any past date accepted if not in a relationship

partner_name._description: Full name of spouse or partner if applicable

prior_relationships._description: Prior marriages or de facto relationships

prior_relationship_children._description: Whether there are children from a prior relationship

litigation._description: Whether client 1 is involved in litigation or legal proceedings (Part D — Additional Information)

additional_info._description: Anything else the client wants Nautilus to know; 'None' accepted

declaration_date._description: Date client signed the declaration in Part D

financial._description: Asset and liability information. Structure depends on disclosure_level.

disclosure_level._description: Controls which financial pages are shown and which financial fields are populated
disclosure_level._impact: full = detailed per-asset fields populated; summary = only summary_totals populated; discuss = all financial arrays empty

properties._description: Real property holdings. Empty array if disclosure_level is not 'full' or client has no property.

value._description: Estimated value in dollars (free text, e.g. '850000')

crypto._description: Free text description of crypto holdings. null if client answered No to 'Do you have crypto?'

foreign_assets._description: Free text description of foreign assets. null if No.

secured_property._description: Address of property secured by mortgage

guarantees._description: Free text description of guarantees given. null if No.

other_assets._description: Free text notes on other assets not captured above (artwork, vehicles, etc.)

summary_totals._description: Approximate totals only — shown instead of itemised assets when client chose summary disclosure. null if disclosure_level !== 'summary'.

properties._description: Approximate total property value in dollars

business._description: Business interests, trusts, SMSFs, and insurance from Part B

businesses._description: Sole trader or partnership interests (not companies, which are a separate Part B page not currently mapped to the payload — see note)
businesses._note: Companies entered on the Companies page in Part B are currently NOT mapped into the webhook payload. Only businesses from the 'Business Interests' page (sole trader/partnership) are mapped here via bData.c1Businesses.

smsf._description: Whether client has an SMSF. Note: full SMSF detail (members, LRBA, trustee) is collected in the form but not included in the payload — only the Yes/No flag is sent.

trauma_count._description: Number of trauma insurance policies (count only — policy details not captured)

income_protection_count._description: Number of income protection policies (count only — policy details not captured)

will._description: Will distribution and executor details from Part C

existing_will_location._description: Where the existing Will is currently kept

will_storage_preference._description: Where the client wants the new Will to be stored

executors._description: Appointed executors. At least 1 required (2 recommended). Each is a Person object.

agreed_to_act._description: Whether this person has agreed to act as executor

distribution_primary._description: Primary distribution scenario — the client's first-choice distribution of their estate

hasGifts._description: Whether there are any specific gifts

desc._description: Description of the specific gift (e.g. 'My 1967 Mustang')

hasSub._description: Whether there is a substitute gift if the original no longer exists

resBenes._description: Residuary estate beneficiaries — who receives the remainder after specific gifts

pct._description: Percentage share of residuary estate (0–100). All resBenes must sum to exactly 100.

tt._description: Whether a testamentary trust is desired for this beneficiary's share

distribution_contingency._description: Contingency distribution scenario — the backup if primary beneficiaries do not survive. Same structure as distribution_primary.

epa._description: Enduring Power of Attorney details from Part D

_allowed_values: Yes — I wish to make a new EPA
Yes — I wish to update an existing EPA
No — I do not wish to make one at this time
health_personal._description: Client's EPA decision for health and personal matters

health_attorneys._description: Appointed health & personal attorneys. Same Person schema as executors.

_allowed_values: Yes — I wish to make a new EPA
Yes — I wish to update an existing EPA
No — I do not wish to make one at this time
financial._description: Client's EPA decision for financial matters

financial_attorneys._description: Appointed financial attorneys. Same Person schema as executors.

_allowed_values: Only if I lose capacity (as certified by a doctor)
financial_epa_trigger._description: When the financial EPA takes effect

_allowed_values: Yes — I wish to make one
I wish all reasonable treatment to be provided
I wish treatment to be withdrawn if there is no reasonable chance of recovery
I wish to discuss this with my attorney and medical team
life_sustaining._description: Life-sustaining treatment preference in terminal illness or permanent unconsciousness

_allowed_values: I consent to donation of any/all organs and tissue
I consent to donation of specific organs only (please specify in additional info)
I do not consent to organ donation
To discuss / no decision at this time

funeral._description: Funeral and legacy wishes from Part D. Not legally binding but guidance for loved ones.

religious_observances._description: Free text — religious or cultural observances for funeral; 'None' accepted

legacy_wishes._description: Free text — personal messages or legacy wishes; 'None' accepted

client_2._description: Identical structure to client_1 above. null for Single Client engagements.
client_2._note: client_2.litigation and client_2.additional_info are sourced from dData.c2Litigation and dData.c2AdditionalInfo — however the Part D Additional Information page in the form currently only captures client 1's litigation and additional info fields. client_2 values will be empty strings unless this page is extended.
client_2._schema_ref: Same structure as client_1 — all the same fields apply

family._description: Shared family information — children, parents, dependants

children._description: For couples who share children (sameChildren=Yes or single), uses childJoint list. For couples with different children (sameChildren=No), merges c1Children and c2Children lists.

name._description: Full name including maiden name; 'Unknown' accepted

other_dependants._description: Free text description of other financially dependent persons. null if No.

grandchildren_detail._description: Free text grandchildren details. null if No.

family_provision_risk._description: Risk of a family provision claim against the estate

family_provision_detail._description: Free text details of the family provision risk

guardians._condition: Any child's date of birth makes them under 18 at time of form completion
guardians._description: Appointed guardians for minor children. Only appears when there are minor children present in the children list. Empty array otherwise.

_items._schema_ref: PERSON_SCHEMA — same as executor objects above

accountant._description: Accountant name or firm name; 'None' accepted

accountant_authority._description: Whether client authorises Nautilus to contact their accountant

beneficiary_profiles._description: Keyed by full name (first last) of each named beneficiary across all distribution scenarios. Auto-populated from the names entered in distribution_primary and distribution_contingency for all clients.

_allowed_values: High — capable of managing a large inheritance
Moderate — may benefit from staged distributions
literacy._description: Financial maturity / literacy assessment for this beneficiary

needsTT._description: Whether a testamentary trust is desired to protect this beneficiary's inheritance

Jane Smith.literacy: High — capable of managing a large inheritance

uploaded_documents._description: Files uploaded by the client in the Document Upload page of Part B. Each element is a URL string pointing to a presigned Cloudflare R2 download URL valid for 7 days.

_items._format: URL — presigned Cloudflare R2 download link
_items._description: Direct download URL for the uploaded document. Expires 7 days after upload.
_items._note: If R2 credentials are not configured on the server, this array will be empty or contain error entries.

_PERSON_SCHEMA_REFERENCE._description: Reusable person object used for: executors, health attorneys, financial attorneys, guardians. All fields are optional in the schema but first/last are required in the form.

_FIELDS_NOT_IN_PAYLOAD._description: These fields are collected in the form but are NOT currently included in the webhook payload. Flagged here for completeness.
_FIELDS_NOT_IN_PAYLOAD.companies: Full company details (name, directors, shareholders, activity, net value, debt) from Part B Companies pages are collected but not mapped to the payload.
_FIELDS_NOT_IN_PAYLOAD.smsf_detail: SMSF detail beyond Yes/No (fund name, trustee, members, LRBA) is collected in Part B but not sent. Only has_smsf flag is included.
_FIELDS_NOT_IN_PAYLOAD.c2_litigation_and_additional_info: The Part D Additional Information page only captures c1Litigation and c1AdditionalInfo. Client 2 equivalents will be empty strings in the payload.
_FIELDS_NOT_IN_PAYLOAD.will_mirror_structure: cData.mirrorWill (Will structure preference for couples) is not included in the payload.
_FIELDS_NOT_IN_PAYLOAD.same_children_flag: aData.sameChildren (whether couple shares children) is not sent — its effect is already resolved in the merged children array.

_RELATIONSHIP_OPTIONS_REFERENCE._description: Options available in the Relationship dropdown used for beneficiaries, gifts, executors, attorneys, guardians. Sourced from src/constants/relationshipOptions.js
_RELATIONSHIP_OPTIONS_REFERENCE._note: Read the file src/constants/relationshipOptions.js for the exact current list. Common values include: Spouse/Partner, Child, Stepchild, Grandchild, Parent, Sibling, Niece/Nephew, Friend, Solicitor, Accountant, Other
